'''Nishalorite stones''' were [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]] found on worlds with strong magnetic fields. They were discovered by a wandering [[Unidentified Jedi Seeker/Legends|Jedi Seeker]]. The stones they produced a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] blade that detected and reacted to such magnetic fields, such as intensifying in the direction of magnetic north.<ref name="Savage Spirits" />
